title.narrative: Mentoring as a Way Forward 2.0 - Support

description.narrative: The Youth leaders will be attached to the VU-YWCA international project “Mentoring as a way forward 2.0”. This project wishes to target the shared values of YWCA and VU, by mentoring young people and children in sensitive situations in the society, with the purpose of giving them resources and competences to be part of the civil society. The core activity of the project will be to facilitate mentoring sessions. The activities include recruiting and educating mentors, to better the mental health and life skills of young children and adolescents. Furthermore, to reeducate mentors, from the previous partnership project in the established areas and look into the opportunity of decentralizing and expanding the project in a geographical way and in a political way with an advocacy group. The Youth leaders will oversee the practical design and execution of workshops and mentor education/reeducation seminars. The project will take place from February to June 2023 and will be strengthened by the capacity and presence of a joint effort, commenced both by the YWCA-members and VU-members.
